good_to_know.text: Main Church: closed Monday-Friday; open Saturday from 4pm and all day Sunday.
Temporary Chapel: JM Beurel Centre (Annex Building) Level 1, open Monday-Friday 10am-7pm.
Heritage Gallery open 10am-10pm; heritage tours can be booked at cathedral.catholic.sg/heritage.
Cathedral address: 'A' Queen Street, Singapore 188533; tel 6337 2036.
